name: appstore-review-skill
description: App Store & Google Play rejection checker for mobile apps: audits your project (and built .ipa/.aab) against Apple's App Review Guidelines and Google Play policies before you submit, applies safe fixes, and turns rejection messages into root-cause fixes and Resolution Center replies. Works with Swift, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native, Expo, KMP, .NET MAUI, Capacitor/Cordova/Ionic and Unity.
